title: Weather and Postcards
author: Oscar Marchetti
blurb: Edmund Coldharbour, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
